item.title: Fix bug in window.py so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Operator request (verbatim): "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

Goal: `python3 -m unittest` passes fully. Fix the bug in window.py (the off-by-one suggested by the repo name). Do not modify any test files. The fix must be correct for all valid inputs, including edge cases (empty input, boundary sizes, window larger than input), not just the tested ones. Add no unnecessary comments. Commit the fix on the item's branch with a clear message; do not push.

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in window.py. sliding_windows iterated start indices over range(len(items) - size), which dropped the final window and returned [] when len(items) == size. It now iterates range(len(items) - size + 1). The change is one line, committed on archon/dm3bcz0g-fix-bug-in-window-py-so-python3-m-unitte as 30e9654 (tree 86fa257); nothing was pushed. No test files were changed. Checks: python3 -m unittest before the fix gave failures=2 (test_includes_the_last_window, test_whole_list_is_one_window); after the fix it ran 3 tests, OK. Ad-hoc edge checks passed: [] -> [], [1] with size 2 -> [], [1,2] size 2 -> [[1,2]], size 1 yields each item, size 3 on 3 items yields one window, size 0 raises ValueError. Reviewer agt_01M8ANC8C81GSFK0ETMYKAX3AF (claude-haiku-5-5, effort low) passed head 30e9654 with no findings and confirmed risk low. Nothing left running; no __pycache__ left in the worktree.

pr.body: Approach: the start-index range was one short. Changed window.py line to range(len(items) - size + 1). Empty input and size > len still produce an empty list because the range is empty; size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Checks: python3 -m unittest fails 2 before the fix and passes all 3 after; edge cases checked ad hoc. Assumptions: test_window.py is unchanged. Limits: non-integer size is not validated, same as before.
pr.summary: Made sliding_windows return every window. Now includes the last window and returns [] for size > len. Before: range(len - size) dropped the final window; now: range(len - size + 1).
pr.title: Fix off-by-one in sliding_windows dropping the last window

risk.why: One-line behaviour fix in window.py, no API change. Covered by the three existing tests plus ad-hoc edge cases. Reviewer confirmed low.
